verses.pali: Atha kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then the brahmin Jānussoṇi went up to the Buddha, and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side and said to the Buddha:

verses.pali: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu ko paccayo yena m’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjantī”ti?
verses.english: “What is the cause, worthy Gotama, what is the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell?”

verses.pali: “Katattā ca, brāhmaṇa, akatattā ca.
verses.english: “What they’ve done and what they’ve not done.

verses.pali: Evam’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjantī”ti.
verses.english: That’s why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.”

verses.pali: “Ko pana, bho gotama, hetu ko paccayo yena m’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjantī”ti?
verses.english: “But what is the cause, worthy Gotama, what is the reason why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm?”

verses.pali: “Katattā ca, brāhmaṇa, akatattā ca.
verses.english: “What they’ve done and what they’ve not done.

verses.pali: Evam’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjantī”ti.
verses.english: That’s why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.”

verses.pali: “Na kho ahaṁ imassa bhoto gotamassa saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṁ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṁ ājānāmi.
verses.english: “I don’t understand the meaning of what the worthy Gotama has said in brief, without explaining the details.

verses.pali: Sādhu me bhavaṁ gotamo tathā dhammaṁ desetu yathā ahaṁ imassa bhoto gotamassa saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṁ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṁ ājāneyyan”ti.
verses.english: Worthy Gotama, please teach me this matter in detail so I can understand the meaning.”

verses.pali: “Tena hi, brāhmaṇa, suṇāhi, sādhukaṁ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: “Well then, brahmin, listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bho”ti kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
Bhagavā etadavoca:
“Idha, brāhmaṇa, ekaccassa kāyaduccaritaṁ kataṁ hoti, akataṁ hoti kāyasucaritaṁ;
verses.english: “Firstly, brahmin, someone has done bad things and not done good things by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: vacīduccaritaṁ kataṁ hoti, akataṁ hoti vacīsucaritaṁ;
manoduccaritaṁ kataṁ hoti, akataṁ hoti manosucaritaṁ.
Evaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, katattā ca akatattā ca evam’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjanti.
verses.english: So what they’ve done and what they’ve not done is why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.

verses.pali: Idha pana, brāhmaṇa, ekaccassa kāyasucaritaṁ kataṁ hoti, akataṁ hoti kāyaduccaritaṁ;
verses.english: Furthermore, brahmin, someone has done good things and not done bad things by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: vacīsucaritaṁ kataṁ hoti, akataṁ hoti vacīduccaritaṁ;
manosucaritaṁ kataṁ hoti, akataṁ hoti manoduccaritaṁ.
Evaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, katattā ca akatattā ca evam’idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjantī”ti.
verses.english: So what they’ve done and what they’ve not done is why some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.”

verses.pali: “Abhikkantaṁ, bho gotama …pe… upāsakaṁ maṁ bhavaṁ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṁ saraṇaṁ gatan”ti.
verses.english: “Excellent, worthy Gotama! … From this day forth, may the worthy Gotama remember me as a lay follower who has gone for refuge for life.”
